name: ZEH/LTB Research-Workflow Reference (EdS baseline fragment)
provenance_note: Research lead plan2_z.md describes its own artifacts as unexecuted with no canonical workspace spec available; every series coefficient reused here was re-derived by hand (see README) before use as a golden.
regime: late-time classical GR, irrotational pressureless dust, Lambda=0, central observer, comoving synchronous foliation, units c=G=H0=1

conventions.central_normalization: R'(t0,0)=1 with shared observer event t0=2/3 (load-bearing constitution, not derived)
conventions.distance_reading: area radius R=D_A on the central light cone; rescaled G(Z) notation kept distinct

domain: spherical comoving domain, physical boundary R(t0,rD)=Rphys recomputed per model

obligations.evidence_required: regular cone solution reproducing D_A* exactly

obligations.statement: vertex regularity and analytic existence at the singular cone vertex
obligations.evidence_required: majorant/CKS well-posedness for the vertex-singular ODE

obligations.statement: admissibility and valid off-cone extension of each cone solution
obligations.evidence_required: 1+2E>0, R'>0, rho>0, no shell crossing, t_B from shell-age relation

obligations.statement: backreaction response and a valid nonzero distinguishing result
obligations.evidence_required: Q_2[h]!=0 for an admissible profile under the exact constraint

obligations.statement: perturbative remainder control for the epsilon route
obligations.evidence_required: O(epsilon^3) bound guaranteeing sign for small epsilon

obligations.statement: fixed-physical-boundary shift accounted for in Q_D
obligations.evidence_required: r_D(u) variation included at the relevant order
targeted literature comparison of the Q_D-specific claim

verification.executed: DIFFERENTIATE-001 dM/dr with replayed derivation; EXPR-CANON-001 on EdS theta with replayed derivation; theorem conclusion gate binding output to hand golden; all-r degree-coefficient structural check of dM/dr (arbitrary-precision degrees) plus finite-sample Go rational corroboration of the stored cone expressions, D_A* coefficients, and stored EdS vertex coefficients z1,z2,z3; Verify enforces the exact required assumption set and in-memory-vs-stored correspondence

limitations.statement: No spatial-integration primitive was added (growth gate); the averaging integral is represented, not executed. Expression checks do not prove Q_D=0 by themselves.
Claim statuses live in this manifest, not in any artifact schema; Verify enforces evidence linkage, not epistemic status. Unsupported promotion is rejected by metadata checks only to that extent.
Series coefficients are hand-derived candidate goldens with independent mechanical recomputation in tests, not engine-proved theorems.
No admissible model pair with distinct Q_D is constructed; ZEH-Q-03 remains open with no theorem artifact.
No observational or empirical consequences are represented or claimed.
